watchtower.name: Field Watchtower
watchtower.description: Reliable ranged defense. Persists in the AREA where it is built.

spike_trap.name: Spike Trap
spike_trap.description: Persistent burst trap with strong knockback.

field_camp.name: Field Camp
field_camp.description: Recovery pocket. Useful as a wilderness foothold.

arcane_pylon.name: Arcane Pylon
arcane_pylon.description: Fast magical turret whose shots jump between nearby enemies.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: Persistent defensive wall segment. Enemies are heavily resisted at its footprint.

floor_wood.name: Wood Floor
floor_wood.description: Cheap player-built flooring for roads, rooms and courtyards.

wall_stone.name: Stone Wall
wall_stone.description: Heavy permanent wall. Stronger resistance to enemy movement than a palisade.

gate.name: Fortified Gate
gate.description: A formal gate for a growing settlement perimeter.

torch.name: Frontier Torch
torch.description: Creates a small local spawn-suppression pocket around the flame.

waystone.name: Waystone
waystone.description: A stronger sanctuary anchor and future fast-travel node.

storage.name: Storage House
storage.description: Physical settlement storage. Future item stash interaction happens here.

town_hall.name: Warden Hall
town_hall.description: The physical heart of a settlement. Command, territory administration and upgrades.

farm.name: Farmstead
farm.description: Produces Food from the physical HOME AREA.

lumberyard.name: Lumberyard
lumberyard.description: Produces Wood from the physical HOME AREA.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Produces Stone from the physical HOME AREA.

arcane_lab.name: Arcane Laboratory
arcane_lab.description: Physical magical research station and Mana producer.

stable.name: Stable
stable.description: Supports beasts, mounts and future creature husbandry.
